title: Dream Cycle Scan Summary — 2026-07-19
source: arXiv q-fin list July 2026 (176 papers scanned)

content.thinnest_section: AI Industry (10 pages, least cross-linked relative to depth of recent papers)
content.next_hypothesis: H422 (MACD-parameterized momentum overlay — design note only, no script yet)

papers_actioned.title: Tail Risk Management with Puts and Trend Following: A CVaR Framework
papers_actioned.rationale: Direct application to production portfolio MaxDD protection. Already at -3.60% MaxDD but provides formal CVaR framework for evaluating whether puts add value.

papers_actioned.title: How Much of a 10-K Matters? Aggregation-Dependent Value of Full-Text versus Risk-Factor Sentiment
papers_actioned.rationale: Item 1A text beats full 10-K at firm level for returns AND volatility prediction. PEAD pipeline improvement: pre-filter H174 universe using annual 10-K risk factor sentiment before earnings event.

papers_actioned.title: When Directional Accuracy Lies: Base-Rate-Honest Benchmark for LoRA-Adapted TimesFM
papers_actioned.action: New wiki page (new_page proposal #3 — AI Industry expansion)
papers_actioned.rationale: Critical methodological finding: LLM directional accuracy claims systematically inflated by bull-market base rates. Full honest-benchmark protocol documented. Directly informs H381/H382 LLM alpha proposals.

papers_actioned.title: Portfolio Optimization under Fast and Slow Latent Mean-Reverting and Momentum Drift
papers_actioned.rationale: Provides theoretical justification that MACD = optimal latent factor estimator. Explains WHY H301 (200d MA) + H362 (VIX<20) + H296 (VIX TS) are jointly powerful — dual timescale information-theoretic optimality.

papers_noted_not_actioned.title: Forecasting Realized Volatility with Time Series Foundation Models
papers_noted_not_actioned.reason: Key finding (foundation models barely beat Log-HAR) already reflected in existing ts-foundation-models.md wiki page. TTM + Log-HAR ensemble worth noting but no new hypothesis or page warranted.

papers_noted_not_actioned.title: Relief-Gated Relative Rotation for QQQ-DIA Allocation
papers_noted_not_actioned.reason: 354-506% annual turnover makes it impractical. Walk-forward validation methodology interesting but result not directly applicable to monthly-rebalance production system.

papers_noted_not_actioned.title: Estimating the Stochastic Discount Factor from Option Prices and Predicting the Equity Premium
papers_noted_not_actioned.reason: Requires SPX options data (Polygon paid tier). H309 dispersion trading already in pipeline for options. SDF prediction is institutional-level allocation, not actionable at our scale.

papers_noted_not_actioned.title: Measuring Sentiment News with Transformer-Based Language Models
papers_noted_not_actioned.reason: Validates FinBERT methodology we already use. No new signal — confirmation of existing approach. News sentiment (vs 8-K press releases) already covered in alternative-data.md.

papers_noted_not_actioned.title: When and Why Naive Diversification Works: A Simple Diagnostic Strategy
papers_noted_not_actioned.reason: Horizon-dependent equal-weighting guidance interesting but production portfolio is top-1 momentum (not equal-weight optimization problem). 1/N diagnostic useful if we revisit portfolio blending in H318.

content.wiki_expansion_summary: AI Industry section expanded with new page: base-rate-trap-llm-trading-2026.md. This synthesizes arXiv:2607.12248 (TimesFM base-rate trap), arXiv:2607.05291 (vol foundation models vs Log-HAR), with existing pages on KTD-Fin (momentum beta disguised as LLM alpha), Agentic Trading Survey (reproducibility crisis), and Chen & Welch 2026 (anomaly decay). Provides actionable checklist for all future LLM alpha proposals.
